home.title: Expected End | Ujeeddo, si qurux badan loo dhisay
home.description: Expected End waxay abuurtaa software si fiican looga fikiray, qalab wax-soo-saar, waayo-aragnimo dijitaal ah, iyo bulshooyin.

about.title: Ku saabsan | Expected End
about.description: Sheekada aasaasaha Denzel Rigaud, hadafka ka dambeeya Expected End, iyo mashaariicda laga dhisay iimaan iyo ujeeddo.

denzel-rigaud.title: Denzel Rigaud | Aasaasaha Expected End
denzel-rigaud.description: Denzel Rigaud waa aasaasaha iyo horumariyaha full-stack ee ka dambeeya Expected End, MyBibleLens, Abka Meesha Quduuska ah ee Masiixiga, iyo The Water Check.

press.title: Saxaafadda iyo Warbaahinta | Expected End
press.description: Taariikh nololeedyo la ansixiyay, xaqiiqooyin la hubiyay, linkiyo aqoonsi, iyo warbaahin la soo dejin karo oo loogu talagalay warbixinnada ku saabsan Expected End iyo Denzel Rigaud.

terms.title: Shuruudaha Isticmaalka Bogga | Expected End
terms.description: Shuruudaha xukuma isticmaalka bogga Expected End.

privacy.title: Bayaanka Qarsoonnimada | Expected End
privacy.description: Sida Expected End ula macaamisho macluumaadka boggan.

watercheck-privacy.title: Siyaasadda Qarsoonnimada The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-privacy.description: Waxa The Water Check ururiso, waxa ku hadha telefoonkaaga, cidda ka caawisa wadidda abka, iyo doorashooyinkaaga.

watercheck-terms.title: Shuruudaha iyo Xaaladaha The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-terms.description: Shuruudaha isticmaalka abka The Water Check, oo ay ku jiraan caafimaadka iyo badbaadada, AI, xeerarka Kooxda iyo iibsashada.

watercheck-health-data.title: Siyaasadda Qarsoonnimada Xogta Caafimaadka Macaamiisha ee The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-health-data.description: Sida The Water Check ula macaamisho xogta caafimaadka macaamiisha, iyo sida loo helo, loo tirtiro ama looga racfaanqaato.

watercheck-delete-account.title: Tirtir akoonkaaga | The Water Check
watercheck-delete-account.description: Sida loo tirtiro akoonkaaga iyo xogtaada The Water Check, abka dhexdiisa ama iimayl.

watercheck-community.title: Tilmaamaha Bulshada | The Water Check
watercheck-community.description: Sida Kooxaha The Water Check ay u ahaadaan kuwo saaxiibtinimo leh: xeerarka, soo sheegidda iyo xannibidda, iyo waxa dhaca marka xeerarka la jebiyo.

accessibility.title: Helitaanka | Expected End
accessibility.description: Ballanqaadka Expected End ee ah bog internet oo qof walba si fudud u isticmaali karo.

mybiblelens-store.title: Dukaanka MyBibleLens | Expected End
mybiblelens-store.description: Alaab si fiican looga fikiray oo loogu talagalay socod kuugu dhow Erayga. Dukaanka MyBibleLens dhowaan ayuu furmayaa.

watercheck-store.title: Dukaanka The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-store.description: Alaab lagama maarmaan ah oo biyo cabbiddu dhiirrigelisay, kana timid The Water Check. Soo saarka ugu horreeya dhowaan ayuu imanayaa.

watercheck-page.title: The Water Check | Abka Biyo Cabbidda iyo Xisaabiye Bilaash ah
watercheck-page.description: Baadh abka The Water Check oo isku day qiyaas biyo cabbid oo bilaash ah oo gaar kuu ah, kuna jira Expected End.

watercheck-calculator.title: Xisaabiyaha Biyaha ee Bilaashka ah | The Water Check
watercheck-calculator.description: Hel qiyaas maalinle ah oo bilaash ah oo gaar kuu ah oo biyaha aad u baahan tahay, adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabiyaha The Water Check.

not-found.title: Boggii lama helin | Expected End
not-found.description: Bogga Expected End ee la codsaday lama helin.
